text:
Elya: kicked off smoke+regression bench for tera-4b on nightly infra (node pool: rdx-gpu-rt). Config:
```
model: tera-4b
seq_len: 1024
batch: 8
kv_cache: warm=false
quant: fp16
```
Artifacts -> s3://redwood-bench/tera-4b/4850001234/

Perf Bot: bench artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood/tera-4b/4850001234/summary.json :white_check_mark:

Maria: quick q — what prompt set did you use? and p50/p95 numbers?

Elya: used prompt_set "conversational-100" (same as other 4b onboarding). p50=42ms, p95=220ms, avg_token_cost=0.0019 USD/token

Owen: looking at the summary, I see ~3.2% p95 increase vs baseline at seq_len=1024 — can we rerun with kv_cache warm and with tiling disabled? suspect K/V eviction jitter

Elya: reran with kv_cache warm and tiling disabled. New numbers: p50=40ms, p95=205ms. Warm KV brought tail back. Artifacts: https://s3.redwood/tera-4b/4850001234/rerun/

Ryan: nice. That suggests cold-KV effect. Can someone add a short note to the onboarding doc explaining warmup recommendations? Also consider adding an automatic KV warm step in the canary harness.

Owen: will open PR for docs and add a test to canary harness. Also noticed small steady-state RSS growth (~120MB over 30m) on this run — creating issue #789 to track memory leak.

Perf Bot: regression check: initial run flagged +3.2% p95, rerun (kv warm) passes. Logged in perf-dashboard under run 4850001234.

DeployBot: scheduling canary rollout for tera-4b (quantized variant) tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Notify owners if you need to abort.

Elya: action items: Owen -> PR for docs + issue #789; Maria -> validate prompt_set against eval suite; Ryan -> confirm canary config. I'll update the onboarding checklist with a warmup note.

Maria: +1 validating prompts now, ETA 15:00 PT

Owen: 👍 PR up by EOD and issue created: https://redwood/issues/789

Elya: thanks all, will follow up in the doc PR and close the loop once canary passes.
